Hugill, J.A., Overbeek, J.P. and Spoelstra, S. (2001). A comparison of the eco-efficiency of two production routes for methanol. ECN-I--01-003, ECN Energy Efficiency in Industry, Petten, February 2001 (definitive version 2 February 2001). Final report of ENGINE project Eco-efficiency of chemical processes (project nr. 76188).

Exergy/LCA methodology case study, not a cost study: no capex or opex anywhere. Loaded: conventional SMR methanol plant (Aspen model with CO2 addition) electricity import 213 kWh/t and LP steam import (derived 302 kWh/t) per t methanol, natural gas feed and furnace-fuel mass flows and CO2 feed as flows; Lurgi quoted 20 kWh/t; photo-electrochemical reactor efficiency 5% and lifetime 20 yr. Not loaded: Eco-indicator ecopoints (other-values only), construction material quantities. Natural gas is given only by mass and exergy, so no GJ/t natural-gas SEC row was written. Locator: printed page numbers. Traps: model is explicitly unoptimised (authors say electricity and steam imports likely overestimated); comma decimals in tables.
